! Game text
| Deploy on table. If you have any {{Errata hl|1=non-Imperial characters (or starships)}} on table, place in Lost Pile. {{Errata hl|1=Neither player may draw more than two battle destiny in a battle.}} Whenever you initiate (or win) a battle, you {{Errata hl|1=may retrieve any one Imperial}}, and {{Errata hl|1=once per turn, whenever you draw an Imperial for destiny}}, you may take that card into hand to cause a redraw. {{Errata hl|1=Suspended while opponent occupies more locations than you do}}. [Immune to Alter] || Deploy on table. If your {{Errata hl|1=non-Imperial character or [Independent] starship}} on table, this Effect lost. {{Errata hl|1=Unless you occupy fewer locations than opponent}}: if you initiate or win a battle, {{Errata hl|1=retrieve an Imperial}}; {{Errata hl|1=during battle}}, may take an Imperial just drawn for destiny into hand to redraw. (Immune to Alter.)
